## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

With Computable as the allowed class on both sides, a source predicate with no computable total decider and a computable validity-preserving map give proposal validity with no computable total decider; for the source predicate that program c halts on input n this is Mathlib's ComputablePred.halting_problem.

### Governing Obligation
Halting is the only source predicate instantiated; no Rice instance, no extensional property of encoded DTM0 programs and no computable reduction from DTM0 to Nat.Partrec.Code is given.

### Witness Audit
Written during recovery, not recovered: compiled with lean v4.35.0 against the Mathlib v4.35.0 build, exit 0 and no warning, but it is not a lakefile root, so the repository build does not replay it. Axioms are propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, all from Mathlib's computability library. The first theorem restates ComputablePred.halting_problem through ComputablePred.computable_iff. The binding manifest does not list this declaration; the claim of PROVED_LEAN is the recovery notes (FORMAL_RECOVERY_NOTES.md:85-91), which record it as new and compiled outside lake.
